title: 第17章 烤羊腿香第18章 兽宠强化部位
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
“小东西？”
李秀儿立刻忘了羊肉的事，好奇地睁大了眼睛。
李玄小心翼翼地从怀里，贴身的温热处，掏出了那个被旧布片裹着的小小一团。
掀开一角，一个毛茸茸、灰扑扑的小脑袋露了出来，湿漉漉的黑鼻子轻轻翕动，眼睛还没完全睁开，发出细微的“呜呜”
声。
“哇！
是小狗！”
李秀儿惊喜地叫起来，伸手就想抱。
“哎，小心点，它还小，冻坏了。”
李玄小心地将小狼崽放到妹妹手里。
小狼崽感受到温暖，本能地往李秀儿怀里钻了钻。
李秀儿顿时爱不释手，轻轻摸着它柔软的绒毛，脸上笑开了花。
李山和李忠也凑过来看稀奇。
“这是……狼崽子？”
李山阅历丰富，一眼就看出不对劲，眉头立刻皱了起来，语气严肃，
“玄儿，你怎么把这玩意儿带回来了？狼崽子养不熟的！
而且母狼最是护崽记仇，万一循着气味找上门来，可是大祸！”
李忠闻言也紧张起来。
李玄早有准备，平静地解释：“爹，您放心。
这崽子是被遗弃在荒草窝里的，冻得就剩一口气了，附近也没有大狼活动的痕迹，应该是狼群迁徙或者出了意外丢下的。”

“我带它回来时很小心，雪这么大，气味早没了。
它这么小，离了人活不了，我看着……也是个缘分。”
他没有提及面板契约之事，只是从情理上解释。
听他这么说，又见那小狼崽在孙女怀里瑟瑟发抖、柔弱可怜的样子。
李山紧绷的脸色缓和了些，但仍是告诫：
“既然带回来了，就仔细些养着吧。
不过得多留个心眼，毕竟是野物。”
见老爷子松口，李秀儿更是高兴，小心翼翼地抱着狼崽，嘴里已经盘算着给它找什么吃的了。
这一番热闹下来，天色更暗，雪也渐渐小了。
一直安静站在角落的杏儿，看着李家其乐融融的景象。
看着那冒着热气的灶房和令人心安的羊腿肉香，眼中满是羡慕和一丝不易察觉的落寞。
她悄悄挪动脚步，小声对李秀儿说：“秀儿，天不早了，我……我先回去了。”
她家就在村尾，父母早亡，跟着年迈多病的奶奶过活，家徒四壁，吃了上顿没下顿是常事。
这年头，谁家都不宽裕，有点好东西都紧着自家人，她懂事，从不敢奢望。
“啊？这就走啊？”
content_en:
"Little thing?"
Li Xiuer immediately forgot about the mutton and opened her eyes curiously.
Li Xuan carefully took out the small ball wrapped in old cloth from the warm place next to his arms.
Opening a corner, a furry, gray little head was revealed, with a wet black nose twitching slightly, and before its eyes were fully opened, it let out a small "woo woo"
sound.
"Wow!
It's a puppy! "
Li Xiuer screamed in surprise and reached out to hug her.
"Hey, be careful, it's still little and it's frozen."
Li Xuan carefully put the little wolf cub into his sister's hands.
The little wolf cub felt the warmth and instinctively crawled into Li Xiuer's arms.
Li Xiuer couldn't put it down immediately. She gently touched its soft down and smiled broadly.
Li Shan and Li Zhong also came over to see what was strange.
"Is this... a wolf cub?"
Li Shan had rich experience and could tell something was wrong at a glance. He immediately frowned and spoke in a serious tone.
"Xuan'er, why did you bring this thing back? You're not a familiar wolf cub!
Moreover, the female wolf is most protective of its cubs and bears a grudge. If it follows the scent and comes to the door, it will be a big disaster! "
Li Zhong also became nervous after hearing this.
Li Xuan was prepared and explained calmly: "Dad, don't worry.
This cub was abandoned in a den in the wild grass. It was so cold that it was barely alive. There were no traces of large wolf activity nearby. It should have been left behind when the wolves migrated or had an accident. "
"I was very careful when I brought it back. The snow was so heavy that the smell had long gone.
It is so small that it cannot live without people. I look at it... It is also a fate. "
He didn't mention the panel contract, he just explained it logically.
Hearing what he said, I saw the little wolf cub trembling in the arms of my granddaughter again, looking weak and pitiful.
Li Shan's tense expression softened a little, but he still warned:
"Since you brought it back, take care of it carefully.
But be careful, they are wild animals after all. "
Seeing that the old man relented, Li Xiuer was even more happy. She hugged the wolf cub carefully and was already thinking about finding something to eat for it.
After this excitement, the sky became darker and the snow gradually became lighter.
Myolie, who had been standing quietly in the corner, looked at the happy scene of the Li family.
Looking at the steaming stove and the reassuring smell of lamb leg, my eyes were full of envy and a hint of unnoticeable loneliness.
She moved quietly and whispered to Li Xiu'er: "Xiu'er, it's getting late. I... I'm going back first."
Her family is at the end of the village. Her parents died young and she lives with her elderly and sick grandmother. The family is destitute and it is common for her to have a meal without finishing.
These days, no one is well-off, and good things are always close to their own family. She is sensible and never dares to hope for them.
"Ah? Are you leaving now?"
